entries.title: Cutoff planar Gaussian angle-increment field
entries.statement: For beta,K,Lambda>0, g is the centered real Gaussian field on R^2 anchored by g(0)=0 with covariance E[g(x)g(y)]=integral_{0<|k|<Lambda}(exp(i k.x)-1)(exp(-i k.y)-1)/(beta K |k|^2) d^2k/(2pi)^2. The integral is a finite positive Gram kernel. Its stationary increment variance v(x-y)=F(Lambda|x-y|)/(pi beta K), with F(z)=integral_0^z(1-J0(t))dt/t, is (pi beta K)^-1 log|x-y|+O(1) at large separation. This is an explicit auxiliary field, not a microscopic Riesz Gibbs identification.

entries.title: DRAFT: quantized angle variance does not determine periodic order
entries.statement: DRAFT AUTHOR-PROVED AUXILIARY COUNTEREXAMPLE, pending independent w548 review. Let g be the cutoff planar Gaussian increment field, m=6, h=2pi/m, and U,V independent uniforms in [0,h), independent of g. Set q(x)=h floor((g(x)+V)/h), theta=U+q. The field q has stationary increments. With v=Var[g(x)-g(y)], v<=Var[q(x)-q(y)]<=v+h^2/4, so its variance grows logarithmically with bounded error. However E exp[i6(theta(x)-theta(y))]=1 identically and E exp(i6theta(x))=0. This disproves a variance-only inference for periodic order, not the existence of a hexatic Riesz Gibbs phase.

entries.title: DRAFT: smooth bounded perturbations can retain orientational order
entries.statement: DRAFT AUTHOR-PROVED AUXILIARY COUNTEREXAMPLE, pending independent w548 review. Let g be the cutoff planar Gaussian increment field, m=6, h=2pi/m, 0<A<1/m, and U,V independent uniforms on [0,h), independent of g. Put f_A(t)=t+A sin(mt), q_A(x)=f_A(g(x)+V)-f_A(V), theta_A=U+q_A. The map f_A is smooth strictly increasing, |q_A-g|<=2A, and q_A has stationary increments. With v=Var[g(x)-g(y)], Var[q_A(x)-q_A(y)]=v+A^2(1-exp(-m^2v/2)). Yet C_m(x-y)=E exp[i m(theta_A(x)-theta_A(y))] tends to J1(mA)^2>0. Its m-fold phase field is stationary with zero one-point mean. Hence even a smooth bounded monotone perturbation with logarithmic variance correct to O(1) can fail algebraic decay of periodic order. This is not a Riesz Gibbs model or a P0321 solution.
assumptions: specified real Gaussian stationary-increment field with finite UV cutoff

entries.title: Rejected route: logarithmic variance alone implies sixfold decay
entries.statement: DRAFT ROUTE AUDIT, pending independent w548 review. The proposed implication that stationary angle increments with Var(theta(x)-theta(y))=c log|x-y|+O(1), c>0, automatically give algebraically vanishing E exp[i6(theta(x)-theta(y))] is FALSE for general non-Gaussian fields. The quantized construction has correlation 1, and the smooth bounded monotone construction has positive plateau J1(6A)^2 despite preserving the Gaussian variance within A^2. Gaussianity or direct periodic characteristic-function estimates must be part of a valid inference. These auxiliary counterexamples do not refute P0321.
assumptions: proposed bridge assumes stationary increments and logarithmic variance
bridge does not assume an exactly Gaussian angular law

entries.title: DRAFT: the unresolved microscopic hexatic transfer gap
entries.statement: P0321 OPENNESS UNKNOWN as checked 2026-10-10; no solution claimed. The remaining gap in this attempt is a uniform defect-sensitive transfer from an actual neutralized two-dimensional Riesz Gibbs ensemble on a nonempty finite-temperature interval to the orientational characteristic function and fast positional decorrelation in the SAME thermodynamic state, with measurable bond observables specified. Defect-free phonons give a positive orientational plateau and algebraic positional order; a Gaussian variance approximation alone also fails by the explicit non-Gaussian counterexamples. Control of dislocations/disclinations and of periodic characteristic functions is missing. This is a draft gap record, not a theorem about the Gibbs gas.
assumptions: actual Riesz Gibbs law and neutralization must be specified
phase interval is nonempty and at finite positive temperature

relations.rationale: The explicit construction q=h floor((g+V)/h) uses the specified stationary Gaussian increments; its variance differs from v by at most h^2/4.
The construction f_A(g+V)-f_A(V) uses the same g, and the Gaussian increment characteristic function enters its exact variance and Fourier correlation.
Both preserve logarithmic increment variance up to a bounded error and retain periodic long-range order; the smooth version additionally uses a strictly increasing smooth f_A.
The rejected bridge predicts vanishing sixfold correlation from c log r+O(1) variance, but q has that variance and its sixfold correlation is identically 1.
The rejected variance-only inference predicts decaying periodic order; the smooth stationary-increment example has variance v+O(1) and positive limit J1(6A)^2.
The gap record requires characteristic-function transfer because the smooth construction shows covariance accuracy alone can give the wrong order behavior.
This is the remaining gap of the P0321 attempt. The existing card asks for intermediate orientational order without crystalline positional order; no solves/proves relation is asserted.
